sara_sales: Hi team — CrestBank SIG due Friday EOD. Can we get Q12-18 evidence (encryption, key mgmt, network controls)? Customer expects attachments and an evidence manifest. POC running; they asked for demo creds but security flagged it. Anyone free to pull artifacts?
jordan_security: @sara_sales :wave: I'm on it. I uploaded a draft evidence bundle to S3 and added a manifest. Link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/crestbank/2026-03-sig-bundle.zip. Evidence-bot should have posted a checksum.
evidence-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-evidence/crestbank/2026-03-sig-bundle.zip md5=3b8f1c9e :white_check_mark:
ana_engineer: For Q12 (Encryption at rest) copy this snippet from our KMS design doc and include this ACL excerpt. Paste to SIG answer and attach kms_policy.pdf. Snippet:
```
- CMK: aws/kms/redwood-inference-prod
- Key rotation: enabled, 365 days
- HSM: AWS CloudHSM backed (BYOK option)
```
mike_sec_ops: Confirming Q14 (Certificate management) — we use cert-manager + Vault. Attaching cert-rotation.csv and rotation-runbook link. Also flag: CrestBank wants evidence of separation of duties. Recommend redacted IAM activity logs rather than full logs.
sara_sales: Thanks. Two asks from the buyer: 1) Can we provide a signed SOC2 excerpt for relevant control? 2) They want an architecture diagram showing VPC peering for Private deployment. ETA?
jordan_security: SOC2 excerpt: we can provide the SOC2 report cover page and control mapping PDF. Need legal sign-off for sharing full report. Architecture diagram: ana_engineer can generate a cropped diagram showing peering flow. I'll prepare a redaction checklist.
ana_engineer: I'll export diagram today and remove customer-specific IPs. Use this command to pull artifacts:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/crestbank/2026-03-sig-bundle.zip ./ && unzip 2026-03-sig-bundle.zip
```
Will add diagram under /architecture/peering.pdf
mike_sec_ops: For the evidence manifest, please include these fields: control_id, artifact_name, artifact_path, owner, redaction_status, notes. I'll do a quick pass after you upload.
sara_sales: Also POC question — pricing on Dedicated for 50k tokens/day; buyer asked for committed discount. Jordan/mike, can you propose a standard enterprise discount and mention SLA?
jordan_security: Pricing comment — that'll be a sales/SRE/finance sync. For the SIG thread, note: Dedicated is separate. I'll add a note in manifest linking to pricing proposal doc: https://console.redwood/notes/crestbank-pricing (internal).
evidence-bot: manifest.csv created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/crestbank/manifest.csv
ana_engineer: Uploaded peering.pdf and kms_policy.pdf. Manifest updated with my entries. @mike_sec_ops can you review redaction_status for iam_logs_redacted.pdf?
mike_sec_ops: Reviewing now. Redacted logs look fine. Change: redact user emails and session ids. :thumbsup:
sara_sales: Great. Can we get a final zip and a one-page cover note for customer by Thursday? I'll coordinate delivery and update the ticket.
